svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Control valve (obc-analog-valve, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Box 120x120 px, anchor at (48,48). Bindable properties: _pn_position (default 0): Valve position 0-100 % _pb_open (default false): Open feedback _pb_vertical (default false): Vertical orientation (pipe runs top-bottom) _ps_labelDirection (default 'down'): Readout side: up | down | left | right _pb_alarm (default false): Alarm active (alert frame) _pb_auto (default false): Badge: automatic mode _pb_locked (default false): Badge: command locked _pb_duty (default false): Badge: duty unit _pb_alarmOff (default false): Badge: alarms suppressed _ps_tag (default ''): Numeric equipment ID shown as #NNNN, e.g. 501 (empty = hidden)
